summary.headline: Analysts lean positive, but average target sits below today's price
summary.takeaway: Most of the 49 Wall Street analysts covering Apple rate it positively, and few investors bet against it. However, their average price target is below the current price, and insiders sold more shares than they purchased every month shown.

positives.text: Wall Street analysts give an average score of 2.27 (1 is most positive, 5 most negative). Thirty of 49 analysts rate it positively.
Only 1% of tradable shares are sold short (bets the price falls). Short sellers would need about 3.6 days to close them.
Big institutions own 66.5% of shares. Blackrock alone owns 7.96%, and Vanguard owns 6.57%.

watch_outs.text: Wall Street analysts' average 12-month target is $345.63, below today's price of $354.07. Their targets range widely, from $250.00 to $425.00.
Insiders (company leaders) sold more than they purchased in every month shown, including net selling of $90.3 million in October 2026.
Not all analysts are positive: 3 give a negative rating and 1 the most negative. Barclays kept its Underweight rating on 3 Nov 2026.
